exams.name: GRE Biology Subject Test
exams.blurb: Graduate subject test in biology that ETS discontinued in 2021 along with the Literature in English test; it is no longer administered.

exams.name: GRE Chemistry Subject Test
exams.blurb: Graduate subject test in chemistry discontinued by ETS after the April 2023 administration and no longer available to new test takers.

exams.name: GRE General Test
exams.blurb: Graduate admissions test of just under two hours measuring verbal reasoning, quantitative reasoning and analytical writing.

exams.name: GRE Literature in English Subject Test
exams.blurb: Graduate subject test in English literature retired by ETS in 2021; English doctoral programs now rely on writing samples instead.

exams.name: GRE Mathematics Subject Test
exams.blurb: Computer-delivered subject test of about sixty-six questions on calculus, algebra and additional topics for mathematics graduate applicants.

exams.name: GRE Physics Subject Test
exams.blurb: Two-hour subject test covering classical mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, thermodynamics and specialised physics topics.

exams.name: GRE Psychology Subject Test
exams.blurb: Two-hour subject test of about 144 questions spanning biological, cognitive, social, developmental and clinical areas of psychology.

exams.name: TOEFL Essentials Test
exams.blurb: Shorter adaptive ETS English test of about ninety minutes mixing academic and general tasks, accepted by a narrower set of institutions than the iBT.

exams.name: TOEFL iBT
aka: Test of English as a Foreign Language
exams.blurb: Internet-based academic English test scored 0 to 120 across reading, listening, speaking and writing and accepted by most US universities.

exams.name: TOEFL ITP
exams.blurb: Institutional paper and digital English test used internally for placement and progress monitoring rather than for university admission.

exams.name: TOEFL Junior Tests
exams.blurb: English proficiency tests for students aged eleven and older, used by secondary schools for placement and by some US boarding schools.

exams.name: TOEIC Listening and Reading Test
exams.blurb: Workplace English test scored 10 to 990 that measures listening and reading ability in everyday business and professional settings.

exams.name: TOEIC Speaking and Writing Tests
exams.blurb: Companion TOEIC assessments measuring spoken and written business English through recorded responses and written tasks.

exams.name: IB Career-related Programme
exams.blurb: IB framework for students aged sixteen to nineteen combining Diploma Programme courses with career-related study and a reflective core.

exams.name: IB Creativity, Activity, Service
exams.blurb: Mandatory ungraded Diploma Programme core component requiring a portfolio of creativity, physical activity and service experiences.

exams.name: IB Diploma Programme
exams.blurb: Two-year pre-university qualification scored out of 45 points from six subjects plus the core, widely accepted for US college credit.

exams.name: IB Extended Essay
exams.blurb: Externally assessed 4000-word independent research paper that, with Theory of Knowledge, contributes up to three bonus Diploma points.

exams.name: IB Group 1: Studies in Language and Literature
exams.blurb: Diploma Programme subject group covering Language A literature and language courses in a candidate best language at standard or higher level.

exams.name: IB Group 2: Language Acquisition
exams.blurb: Diploma Programme subject group covering Language B, ab initio and classical language courses for additional-language study.

exams.name: IB Group 3: Individuals and Societies
exams.blurb: Diploma Programme humanities group including history, economics, geography, psychology, global politics, philosophy and digital society.

exams.name: IB Group 4: Sciences
exams.blurb: Diploma Programme experimental sciences group covering biology, chemistry, physics, computer science, design technology and sport science.

exams.name: IB Group 5: Mathematics
exams.blurb: Diploma Programme mathematics group split into Analysis and Approaches and Applications and Interpretation, each at standard or higher level.

exams.name: IB Group 6: The Arts
exams.blurb: Diploma Programme arts group covering visual arts, music, theatre, film and dance, which students may replace with a second subject elsewhere.

exams.name: IB Middle Years Programme eAssessment
exams.blurb: On-screen examinations and ePortfolios leading to the IB MYP Certificate for students in the final year of the Middle Years Programme.

exams.name: IB Theory of Knowledge
exams.blurb: Diploma Programme core course assessed by a 1600-word essay on a prescribed title and an exhibition of three real-world objects.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER Advanced Algebra and Functions
exams.blurb: Computer-adaptive placement test for STEM-track students covering quadratics, functions, radicals, logarithms and trigonometry.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER Arithmetic
exams.blurb: Computer-adaptive placement test on whole numbers, fractions, decimals, percentages and comparisons of values in different formats.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER ESL Language Use
exams.blurb: Placement test for English learners measuring command of English grammar and correct sentence construction in an academic context.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER ESL Listening
exams.blurb: Placement test for English learners measuring comprehension of spoken English in lectures, conversations and everyday settings.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER ESL Reading Skills
exams.blurb: Placement test for English learners measuring comprehension of short English passages, main ideas and inference from context.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER ESL Sentence Meaning
exams.blurb: Placement test for English learners measuring understanding of vocabulary and meaning within single and paired English sentences.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER Quantitative Reasoning, Algebra, and Statistics
exams.blurb: Computer-adaptive placement test for non-STEM tracks covering rational numbers, ratios, linear equations, probability and statistics.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER Reading
exams.blurb: Computer-adaptive college placement test measuring comprehension, rhetoric, synthesis and vocabulary across single and paired passages.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER WritePlacer
exams.blurb: Essay component of ACCUPLACER scored on purpose, organisation, development, sentence variety, mechanics and critical thinking.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER WritePlacer ESL
exams.blurb: Essay component for English learners used with the ACCUPLACER ESL battery to place students into language or credit-bearing courses.

exams.name: ACCUPLACER Writing
exams.blurb: Computer-adaptive placement test on revising and editing multiparagraph text for expression of ideas and standard English conventions.

exams.name: AAMC PREview Professional Readiness Exam
exams.blurb: Situational judgment test used by participating medical schools to assess how applicants respond to pre-professional competency scenarios.

exams.name: Medical College Admission Test
exams.blurb: Seven-and-a-half-hour medical school admissions exam scored 472 to 528 across four sections covering sciences and critical analysis.
